cells.gaps: No source from the last three years has the government both saying digital transformation must be paid for from the country's own resources and acting on it: no fund, levy or assigned tax is shown created, collecting or paying.
cells.note: The communication technologies ministry's 2026 budget is TND 197.3 million against TND 184 million in 2025 (TUN-002), so the money rose. No commitment to pay at home with an act behind it is held, so not 4.
